40021418.author: पदार्थः
40021418.content: ततः then, पितामहं the grandfather, दृष्ट्वा having seen, वायुः Vayu, पुत्रवधार्दितः distressed by the injury of his son, शिशुकं the child, तं that, समादाय having taken, उत्तस्थौ stood up, धातुरग्रतः in front of the creator.

40021418.author: Translation
40021418.content: Then, Vayu, distressed by the injury to his son, having seen the grandfather Brahma, picked up that child and stood up in front of the creator.

40021419.author: पदार्थः
40021419.content: चलकुण्डलमौलिस्रक्तपनीयविभूषणः adorned with swaying earrings, a diadem, garlands, and golden ornaments, पादयोः at the feet, न्यपतत् fell down, वायुः Vayu, तिस्रः having approached the three worlds (or times), उपस्थाय having stood before, वेधसे to the creator (Brahma).

40021419.author: Translation
40021419.content: Vayu, adorned with his moving earrings, crown, garlands, and golden ornaments, approached Brahma and prostrated himself at his feet.

40021420.author: पदार्थः
40021420.content: तम् him, तु indeed, वेदविदा by the knower of Vedas (Brahma), तेन by him, लम्बाभरणशोभिना shining with dangling ornaments, वायुम् Vayu, उत्थाप्य having raised up, हस्तेन with his hand, शिशुम् the child, तम् him, परिमृष्टवान् stroked.

40021420.author: Translation
40021420.content: Brahma, the knower of the Vedas and adorned with dangling ornaments, raised Vayu and then stroked the child (Hanuman) with his hand.

40021421.author: पदार्थः
40021421.content: स्पृष्टमात्रः as soon as he was touched, ततः then, सः he (the child), अथ moreover, सलीलम् playfully, पद्मयोनिना by the lotus-born (Brahma), जलसिक्तम् water-sprinkled, यथा just as, सस्यम् a plant, पुनर्जीवितम् life again, आप्तवान् obtained.

40021421.author: Translation
40021421.content: As soon as the child was playfully touched by Brahma, he regained life, just like a plant revived by water.

40021422.author: पदार्थः
40021422.content: प्राणवन्तम् alive, इमम् this (child), दृष्ट्वा having seen, प्राणः Vayu, गन्धवहः the carrier of smell, मुदा with joy, चचार moved, सर्वभूतेषु among all beings, सन्निरुद्धम् having been restrained, यथा as, पुरा before.

40021422.author: Translation
40021422.content: Seeing the child alive, Vayu, the wind god, joyfully circulated among all beings as he had done before, having previously been restrained.

40021423.author: पदार्थः
40021423.content: मरुद्रोधात् from the obstruction of Vayu, विनिर्मुक्ताः released, ताः those, प्रजाः creatures, मुदिताः joyful, अभवन् became, शीतदाहविनिर्मुक्ताः freed from cold and heat, पद्मिन्यः lotus plants, इव like, साम्बुजाः with lotuses.

40021423.author: Translation
40021423.content: Released from the obstruction of Vayu, all creatures became joyful, just like lotus plants in ponds are revived when freed from extreme cold and heat.

40021424.author: पदार्थः
40021424.content: ततः then, त्रियुग्मः having three pairs, त्रिककुत् three-peaked, त्रिधामा having three abodes, त्रिदशार्चितः worshipped by the gods, ब्रह्मा Brahma, मारुतप्रियकाम्यया with the desire for Vayu's pleasure, देवताः to the gods, उवाच spoke.

40021424.author: Translation
40021424.content: Then, Brahma, who is associated with three pairs, three peaks, and three abodes, and is worshipped by the gods, spoke to the deities out of a desire to please Vayu.

40021425.author: पदार्थः
40021425.content: भो O, महेन्द्रेशवरुणप्रजेश्वरधनेश्वराः Mahendra, Ishvara, Varuna, Prajeshvara, Dhaneshvara, जानताम् even though knowing, अपि even, वः to you, सर्वम् all, वक्ष्यामि I shall speak, श्रूयताम् let it be heard, हितम् beneficial.

40021425.author: Translation
40021425.content: Brahma addressed the gods, including Mahendra, Ishvara, Varuna, Prajeshvara, and Dhaneshvara, stating that even though they might already know, he would speak to them about something beneficial, which they should hear.

40021426.author: पदार्थः
40021426.content: अनेन by this, शिशुना child, कार्यम् work, कर्तव्यम् to be done, वः for you, भविष्यति will be, तत् therefore, वदध्वम् give, वरान् boons, सर्वे all, मारुतस्य of Vayu, अस्य of this, तुष्टये for the satisfaction.

40021426.author: Translation
40021426.content: Brahma declared that this child (Hanuman) would perform a great task for them, and therefore, all the gods should grant boons to him for Vayu's satisfaction.

40021427.author: पदार्थः
40021427.content: ततः then, सहस्रनयनः the thousand-eyed one, प्रीतियुक्तः filled with joy, शुभाननः having an auspicious face, कुशेशयमयीम् made of lotus flowers, मालाम् garland, उत्क्षिप्य lifting up, इदम् this, वचः word, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40021427.author: Translation
40021427.content: Then, Indra, the thousand-eyed god, filled with joy and having an auspicious face, lifted up a lotus garland and spoke these words.

40021428.author: पदार्थः
40021428.content: मत्करोत्सृष्टवज्रेण by the thunderbolt released from my hand, हनुः the jaw, अस्य of this, यथा as, हतः struck, नाम्ना by name, वै indeed, कपिशार्दूलः the tiger among monkeys, भविता will be, हनुमान् Hanuman, इति thus.

40021428.author: Translation
40021428.content: Indra declared that because this child's jaw was struck by the thunderbolt released from his hand, he would indeed be known by the name Hanuman, the tiger among monkeys.

40021429.author: पदार्थः
40021429.content: अहम् I, अस्य to him, प्रदास्यामि will give, परमम् supreme, वरम् boon, अद्भुतम् wonderful, इतः प्रभृति from now on, वज्रस्य by the thunderbolt, मम by me, अवध्यः invulnerable, भविष्यति will be

40021429.author: Translation
40021429.content: I will grant him a supreme and wonderful boon: from this moment forward, he will be invulnerable to my thunderbolt.

40021430.author: पदार्थः
40021430.content: मार्तण्डः the Sun-god, तु and, अब्रवीत् spoke, तत्र there, भगवान् the revered, तिमिरापहः dispeller of darkness, तेजसः of the radiance, अस्य to him, मदीयस्य my own, ददामि I give, शतिकां a hundredth, कलाम् part

40021430.author: Translation
40021430.content: There, the revered Sun-god, dispeller of darkness, then declared, "I bestow upon him a hundredth part of my own radiance."

40021431.author: पदार्थः
40021431.content: यदा when, तु and, शास्त्राणि scriptures, अध्येतुम् to study, शक्तिः ability, अस्य his, भविष्यति will be, तदा then, अस्य to him, शास्त्रम् knowledge, दास्यामि I will give, येन by which, वाग्ग्मी eloquent, भविष्यति he will become

40021431.author: Translation
40021431.content: And when he gains the ability to study scriptures, I will then impart knowledge to him by which he will become eloquent.

40021432.author: पदार्थः
40021432.content: न च and not, अस्य to him, भविता will be, कश्चित् anyone, सदृशः equal, शास्त्रदर्शने in understanding scriptures, वरुणः Varuna, च and, वरम् boon, प्रादात् gave, न अस्य not his, मृत्युः death, भविष्यति will be, वर्षायुतशतेन अपि even by a hundred thousand years (of water), मत्पाशात् from my noose, उदकात् अपि even from water

40021432.author: Translation
40021432.content: No one will be his equal in understanding scriptures, and Varuna also granted a boon that his death will not occur even by a hundred thousand years of water, nor from Varuna's noose or from water itself.

40021433.author: पदार्थः
40021433.content: यमः Yama, दण्डाद् from the mace (or punishment), अवध्यत्वम् invulnerability, अरोगत्वम् freedom from disease, च and, नित्यशः always, वरम् boon, ददामि I give, सन्तुष्टः pleased, अविषादम् freedom from dejection, च and, संयुगे in battle

40021433.author: Translation
40021433.content: Yama, being pleased, declared, "I grant him the boon of invulnerability from my mace, perpetual freedom from disease, and freedom from dejection in battle."

40021434.author: पदार्थः
40021434.content: गदेयं this mace, मामिका mine, न not, एनम् him, संयुगेषु in battles, वधिष्यति will kill, इति thus, एवम् in this manner, वरदः the bestower of boons, प्राह said, तदा then, हि indeed, एकाक्षिपिङ्गलः the one-eyed and tawny (Kubera).

40021434.author: Translation
40021434.content: Then, Kubera, the bestower of boons, declared that his mace would not kill this child in battles.

40021435.author: पदार्थः
40021435.content: मत्तः by me, मदायुधानाम् and by my weapons, च and, न not, वध्यः killable, अयम् this (one), भविष्यति will be, इति thus, एवम् in this manner, शङ्करेणापि even by Shankara, दत्तः given, अस्य to him, परमः supreme, वरः boon.

40021435.author: Translation
40021435.content: In this way, even by Shankara (Shiva), a supreme boon was granted to him, declaring that he would not be killable by Shiva or his weapons.

40021436.author: पदार्थः
40021436.content: सर्वेषाम् of all, ब्रह्मदण्डानाम Brahma's curses/punishments, अवध्यो unkillable, अयम् this (one), भविष्यति will be, दीर्घायुश्च and long-lived, महात्मा great-souled, च and, इति thus, ब्रह्मा Brahma, अब्रवीत् spoke, वचः words.

40021436.author: Translation
40021436.content: Brahma then spoke, declaring that this child would be immune to all of Brahma's curses and would be long-lived and great-souled.

40021437.author: पदार्थः
40021437.content: विश्वकर्मा Vishwakarma, च and, दृष्ट्वा having seen, एनम् him, बालसूर्योपमम् resembling the rising sun, शिशुम् the child, शिल्पिनाम् of artisans, प्रवरः the foremost, प्रादात् gave, वरम् a boon, अस्य to him, महामतिः the great-minded.

40021437.author: Translation
40021437.content: And Vishwakarma, the great-minded and foremost of artisans, having seen the child who resembled the rising sun, granted him a boon.

40021438.author: पदार्थः
40021438.content: मत्कृतानि made by me, च and, शस्त्राणि weapons, यानि which, दिव्यानि divine, संयुगे in battle, तैः by them, अवध्यत्वमापन्नः having attained invincibility, चिरजीवी long-lived, भविष्यति will be.

40021438.author: Translation
40021438.content: Vishwakarma's boon declared that the child would attain invincibility against all divine weapons made by him and would thus be long-lived.

40021439.author: पदार्थः
40021439.content: ततः then, सुराणां of the gods, तु indeed, वरैः by boons, दृष्ट्वा having seen, हि indeed, एनम् him, अलङ्कृतम् adorned/endowed, चतुर्मुखः the four-faced one (Brahma), तुष्टमनाः with a pleased mind, वायुम् to Vayu, आह said, जगद्गुरुः the preceptor of the world,

40021439.author: Translation
40021439.content: After seeing Hanuman endowed with boons from the gods, Brahma, the preceptor of the world, with a pleased mind, spoke to Vayu.

40021440.author: पदार्थः
40021440.content: अमित्राणां of enemies, भयकरः one who causes fear, मित्राणां of friends, अभयङ्करः one who grants fearlessness, अजेयः unconquerable, भविता will be, पुत्रः son, तव your, मारुत O Vayu, मारुतिः Maruti (Hanuman),

40021440.author: Translation
40021440.content: Brahma declared to Vayu that his son, Hanuman, would be a terror to enemies, a protector to friends, and unconquerable.

40021441.author: पदार्थः
40021441.content: कामरूपः having a desired form, कामचारी moving at will, कामगः going where he desires, प्लवतां of jumpers/leapers, वरः the best, भवति will be, अव्याहतगतिः having unhindered movement, कीर्तिमांश्च and glorious/famous, भविष्यति will be,

40021441.author: Translation
40021441.content: Hanuman will possess the ability to assume any form, move anywhere at will, be the foremost among leapers, have unhindered movement, and achieve great fame.

40021442.author: पदार्थः
40021442.content: रावणोत्सादनार्थानि for the destruction of Ravana, रामप्रियकरणि and pleasing to Rama, च and, रोमहर्षकराणि causing hair to stand on end (awe-inspiring), एषः he (Hanuman), कर्ता will do, कर्माणि deeds, संयुगे in battle,

40021442.author: Translation
40021442.content: In battle, Hanuman will perform awe-inspiring deeds that will lead to the destruction of Ravana and be pleasing to Rama.

40021443.author: पदार्थः
40021443.content: एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, तम् him (Vayu), आमन्त्र्य having addressed/taken leave of, मारुतम् Vayu, तु indeed, अमरैः with the gods, सह together, यथागतम् as they had come, ययुः went, सर्वे all, पितामहपुरोगमाः with Brahma at the forefront,

40021443.author: Translation
40021443.content: Having spoken thus and taken leave of Vayu, all the gods, led by Brahma, returned to their respective abodes.

40021444.author: पदार्थः
40021444.content: सः he, अपि also, गन्धवहः the wind-god, पुत्रम् son, प्रगृह्य having taken, गृहम् to home, आनयत् brought, अञ्जनायाः to Anjana, तम् him, आचख्यौ informed, वरदत्तम् boon-given, विनिर्गतः having departed.

40021444.author: Translation
40021444.content: The wind-god, having taken his son, brought him home and, after departing, informed Anjana that the child was a boon.

40021445.author: पदार्थः
40021445.content: राम O Rama, एषः this (Hanuman), वरान् boons, प्राप्य having obtained, वरदानसमन्वितः endowed with boons, आत्मनि in himself, संस्थेन residing, बलेन with strength, सः he, अपूर्यत was filled, यथा like, अर्णवः the ocean.

40021445.author: Translation
40021445.content: O Rama, this Hanuman, having obtained and being endowed with boons, was filled with strength residing within him, just like the ocean.

40021446.author: पदार्थः
40021446.content: तदा then, तरसा with might, पूर्यमाणः being filled, अपि even, वानरपुङ्गवः the best of monkeys, निर्भयः fearless, महर्षीणाम् of great sages, आश्रमेषु in the hermitages, अपराध्यति committed offenses.

40021446.author: Translation
40021446.content: Then, even as he was filled with immense might, the fearless best of monkeys began to commit offenses in the hermitages of the great sages.

40021447.author: पदार्थः
40021447.content: अयम् this (Hanuman), संशान्तानाम् of the peaceful ones, स्रुग्भाण्डानि sacrificial ladles and vessels, अग्निहोत्रम् the sacred fire, च and, वल्कलाजिनसञ्चयान् bark-garments and deer-skin collections, भग्न broken, विच्छिन्न torn, विध्वस्तान् and destroyed, करोति makes.

40021447.author: Translation
40021447.content: This Hanuman would break, tear, and destroy the sacrificial ladles, sacred fires, and collections of bark-garments and deer-skins belonging to the peaceful sages.

40021448.author: पदार्थः
40021448.content: महाबलः the mighty one, एवंविधानि such kinds of, कर्माणि deeds, प्रावर्तत engaged in, (because) शम्भुना by Shiva, सर्वेषाम् of all, ब्रह्मदण्डानाम् curses of Brahmins, अवध्यः immune to, कृतः made (he was).

40021448.author: Translation
40021448.content: The mighty Hanuman engaged in such deeds because he had been made immune to all curses of Brahmins by Lord Shiva.

40021449.author: पदार्थः
40021449.content: जानन्त knowing, ऋषयः the sages, तम् him, वै indeed, सहन्ते tolerate, तस्य his, शक्तितः due to power.

40021449.author: Translation
40021449.content: The sages, knowing his immense power, indeed tolerated his actions.

40021450.author: पदार्थः
40021450.content: यथा just as, केसरिणा by Kesari, तु indeed, एष this, वायुना by Vayu, सः he, अञ्जनासुतः Anjana's son, प्रतिषिद्धः forbidden, अपि even, मर्यादां the boundary, लङ्घयति transgresses, एव indeed, वानरः the monkey.

40021450.author: Translation
40021450.content: Just as this son of Anjana, though forbidden by Kesari and Vayu, indeed transgresses all limits.

40021451.author: पदार्थः
40021451.content: ततः then, महर्षयः the great sages, क्रुद्धाः angered, भृग्वङ्गिरसवंशजाः born in the lineage of Bhrigu and Angiras, शेपुः cursed, एनम् him, रघुश्रेष्ठ O best of Raghu's lineage, न not, अतिक्रुद्धाः excessively angry, अतिमन्यवः excessively wrathful.

40021451.author: Translation
40021451.content: Then, O best of Raghu's lineage, the great sages born in the lineage of Bhrigu and Angiras, though not excessively angry or wrathful, cursed him.

40021452.author: पदार्थः
40021452.content: बाधसे you harass, यत् because, समाश्रित्य relying upon, बलम् strength, अस्मान् us, प्लवङ्गम O monkey, तत् that, दीर्घकालम् for a long time, वेत्तासि you will know (not), न not, अस्माकम् our, शापमोहितः deluded by the curse, यदा when, ते your, स्मार्यते is reminded, कीर्तिः fame, तदा then, ते your, वर्धते increases, बलम् strength.

40021452.author: Translation
40021452.content: O monkey, because you harass us relying on your strength, you will not know that strength for a long time, deluded by our curse; your strength will only increase when your fame and deeds are recalled.

40021453.author: पदार्थः
40021453.content: ततः then, सः he, हृततेजौजाः having his splendor and vigor taken away, महर्षिवचनौजसा by the power of the great sages' words, एषः this (Hanuman), आश्रमाणि the hermitages, तानि those, एव indeed, मृदुभावम् a gentle state, गतः having attained, अचरत् he wandered.

40021453.author: Translation
40021453.content: Then, this Hanuman, having lost his splendor and vigor by the power of the great sages' words, attained a gentle state and wandered only in those hermitages.

40021454.author: पदार्थः
40021454.content: अथ then, ऋक्षरजसो Ṛkṣarajas, नाम named, वालिसुग्रीवयोः of Vali and Sugriva, पिता father, सर्ववानरराजा king of all monkeys, आसीत् was, तेजसा by splendor, भास्करप्रभः radiant like the sun.

40021454.author: Translation
40021454.content: Then, there was a king named Ṛkṣarajas, the father of Vali and Sugriva, who was the king of all monkeys and shone with the radiance of the sun.

40021455.author: पदार्थः
40021455.content: स he, तु indeed, राज्यं rule, चिरं for a long time, कृत्वा having performed, वानराणां of monkeys, हरीश्वरः the lord of monkeys, स he, च and, ऋक्षरजा Ṛkṣarajas, नाम named, कालधर्मेण by the law of time (death), सङ्गतः met.

40021455.author: Translation
40021455.content: Having ruled the kingdom of monkeys for a long time as their lord, Ṛkṣarajas eventually succumbed to the law of time.

40021456.author: पदार्थः
40021456.content: तस्मिन् when he, अस्तमिते had passed away, च and, अथ then, मन्त्रिभिः by the ministers, मन्त्रकोविदैः skilled in counsel, पित्र्ये in the father's, पदे position, कृतो was made, वाली Vali, सुग्रीवो Sugriva, वालिनः of Vali, पदे in the position.

40021456.author: Translation
40021456.content: After Ṛkṣarajas passed away, the wise ministers then placed Vali in his father's position, and Sugriva in Vali's position.

40021457.author: पदार्थः
40021457.content: सुग्रीवेण with Sugriva, समं together, तु indeed, अस्य his (Vali's), अद्वैधं undivided, छिद्रवर्जितम् without flaw, आबाल्यं from childhood, सख्यम् friendship, अभवत् existed, अनिलस्य of the wind, अग्निना with fire, यथा just as.

40021457.author: Translation
40021457.content: Indeed, his (Vali's) friendship with Sugriva was undivided and without flaw from childhood, just like the inseparable bond between wind and fire.

40021458.author: पदार्थः
40021458.content: एष this (Sugriva), शापवशात् due to a curse, एव only, न not, वेद knows, बलम् strength, आत्मनः his own, वालिसुग्रीवयोः of Vali and Sugriva, वैरं enmity, यदा when, राम O Rama, समुत्थितम् arose.

40021458.author: Translation
40021458.content: O Rama, it was due to a curse that Sugriva did not know his own strength when the enmity between Vali and Sugriva arose.

40021459.author: पदार्थः
40021459.content: न not, हि indeed, एष this, राम O Rama, सुग्रीवो Sugriva, भ्राम्यमाणो being tossed about, अपि even, वालिना by Vali.

40021459.author: Translation
40021459.content: O Rama, indeed, this Sugriva, even when being tossed about by Vali, is not the one (who is unaware of his own strength).

40021460.author: पदार्थः
40021460.content: देव O Lord, जानाति knows, न not, हि indeed, एष this, बलम् strength, आत्मनि in himself, मारुतिः Maruta's son (Hanuman), ऋषिशाप by a sage's curse, आहृतबलः whose strength was taken away, तदा then, एष this, कपिसत्तमः best of monkeys.

40021460.author: Translation
40021460.content: O Lord, indeed, this son of Maruta (Hanuman) does not know his own strength, because he is the best of monkeys whose power was taken away by a sage's curse.

40021461.author: पदार्थः
40021461.content: सिंहः a lion, कुञ्जररुद्धो obstructed by an elephant, वा or, आस्थितः standing, सहितो accompanied, रणे in battle.

40021461.author: Translation
40021461.content: This fragment describes a lion, either obstructed by an elephant or standing accompanied in battle, likely as part of a simile for Hanuman's strength.

40021462.author: पदार्थः
40021462.content: पराक्रम valor, उत्साह enthusiasm, मति intelligence, प्रताप prowess, सौशील्य good conduct, माधुर्य sweetness, नय policy, अनय imprudence, च and, गाम्भीर्य profundity, चातुर्य cleverness, सुवीर्य great courage, धैर्यैः with fortitude, हनुमतः than Hanuman, कः who, अभ्यधिकः superior, अस्ति is, लोके in the world.

40021462.author: Translation
40021462.content: Who in the world is superior to Hanuman in valor, enthusiasm, intelligence, prowess, good conduct, charm, policy, imprudence, profundity, cleverness, great courage, and fortitude?

40021463.author: पदार्थः
40021463.content: असौ this (Hanuman), पुनर moreover, व्याकरणम् grammar, ग्रहीष्यन desiring to learn, सूर्योन्मुखः facing the sun, प्रष्टुमना with a mind to ask, कपीन्द्रः king of monkeys, उद्यद्गिरेः from the rising mountain, अस्तगिरिम् to the setting mountain, जगाम went, ग्रन्थम् treatise, महत great, धारयन holding, अप्रमेयः immeasurable.

40021463.author: Translation
40021463.content: Moreover, this immeasurable king of monkeys (Hanuman), desiring to learn grammar and with a mind to question, went from the rising mountain to the setting mountain, facing the sun and bearing a great treatise.

40021464.author: पदार्थः
40021464.content: ससूत्रवृत्त्यर्थपदं with sūtras, commentaries, meaning, and words, महार्थं of great meaning, ससङ्ग्रहं with summary, साद्ध्यति masters, वै indeed, कपीन्द्रः the chief of monkeys (Hanuman), न not, हि indeed, अस्य to him, कश्चित् anyone, सदृशः equal, अस्ति is, शास्त्रे in knowledge, वैशारदे in skill, च्छन्दगतौ in prosody, तथैव similarly.

40021464.author: Translation
40021464.content: The chief of monkeys, Hanuman, indeed masters scriptures with their aphorisms, commentaries, meanings, and words, along with their summaries, and truly, no one is his equal in knowledge, skill, or prosody.

40021465.author: पदार्थः
40021465.content: सर्वासु in all, विद्यासु branches of knowledge, तपोविधाने in the practice of austerities, प्रस्पर्धते rivals, अयो he, हि indeed, गुरुं the preceptor, सुराणाम् of the gods (Brihaspati), सः he, अयं this, नवव्याकरणार्थवेत्ता knower of the nine grammars and their meanings, ब्रह्मा Brahma, भविष्यति will become, अपि even, ते your, प्रसादात् by grace.

40021465.author: Translation
40021465.content: Indeed, he rivals the preceptor of the gods (Brihaspati) in all branches of knowledge and in the practice of austerities, and this knower of the nine grammars and their meanings will even become Brahma by your grace.

40021466.author: पदार्थः
40021466.content: प्रवीविवक्षोरिव like the ocean wishing to overflow, सागरस्य of the ocean, लोकान् worlds, दिधक्षोरिव like fire wishing to burn, पावकस्य of fire, युगक्षये at the end of an eon, हि indeed, एव certainly, यथा like, अन्तकस्य of Yama, हनूमतः of Hanuman, स्थास्यति will stand, कः who, पुरस्तात् in front.

40021466.author: Translation
40021466.content: Who indeed will be able to stand before Hanuman, who is like the ocean wishing to overflow, like fire wishing to burn the worlds, or like Yama at the end of an eon?

40021467.author: पदार्थः
40021467.content: एषः this one (Hanuman), एव indeed, च and, अन्ये others, च and, महाकपीन्द्राः great chiefs of monkeys, सुग्रीवमैन्दद्विविदाः Sugriva, Mainda, Dvivida, सनीलाः with Nila, सतारतारेयनलाः with Tara, Tareya, Nala, सरम्भाः with Rambha, त्वत्कारणात् for your sake, राम O Rama, सुरैः by the gods, हि indeed, सृष्टाः created.

40021467.author: Translation
40021467.content: This Hanuman, along with other great monkey chiefs like Sugriva, Mainda, Dvivida, Nila, Tara, Tareya, Nala, and Rambha, were indeed created by the gods for your sake, O Rama.

40021468.author: पदार्थः
40021468.content: तत् that, एतत् this, कथितं has been told, सर्वं all, यत् which, मां me, त्वं you, परिपृच्छसि ask, हनूमतः of Hanuman, बालभावे in childhood, कर्म deed, एतत् this, कथितं has been told, मया by me.

40021468.author: Translation
40021468.content: All that you asked me has been told, and this deed of Hanuman in his childhood has been recounted by me.

40021469.author: पदार्थः
40021469.content: श्रुत्वा having heard, अगस्त्यस्य of Agastya, कथितम् spoken, रामः Rama, सौमित्रिः Lakshmana, एव indeed, च and, विस्मयम् wonder, परमम् great, जग्मुः attained, वानराः monkeys, राक्षसैः with Rakshasas, सह with.

40021469.author: Translation
40021469.content: Having heard what Agastya narrated, Rama, Lakshmana, and also the monkeys along with the Rakshasas, were filled with great astonishment.

40021470.author: पदार्थः
40021470.content: अगस्त्यः Agastya, तु indeed, अब्रवीत् spoke, रामम् to Rama, सर्वम् all, एतत् this, श्रुतम् heard, त्वया by you, दृष्टः seen, सम्भाषितः conversed with, च and, असि you are, राम O Rama, गच्छामहे we depart, वयम् we.

40021470.author: Translation
40021470.content: Agastya then said to Rama, "All this has been heard by you, O Rama; you have seen us and conversed with us, now we depart."

40021471.author: पदार्थः
40021471.content: श्रुत्वा having heard, एतत् this, राघवः Rama, वाक्यम् speech, अगस्त्यस्य of Agastya, उग्रतेजसः of mighty ascetic power, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, प्रणतः bowed down, च and, अपि also, महर्षिम् to the great sage, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40021471.author: Translation
40021471.content: Having heard this speech of Agastya, who possessed mighty ascetic power, Rama, with folded hands and bowing down, spoke this to the great sage.

40021472.author: पदार्थः
40021472.content: अद्य today, मे my, देवताः deities, हृष्टाः pleased, पितरः ancestors, प्रपितामहाः great-grandfathers, युष्माकम् your, दर्शनात् by the sight, एव only, नित्यम् always, तुष्टाः satisfied, सबान्धवाः with relatives.

40021472.author: Translation
40021472.content: Rama declared that today his deities, ancestors, and great-grandfathers, along with their relatives, were always pleased merely by the sight of Agastya.

40021473.author: पदार्थः
40021473.content: विज्ञाप्यम् a request, तु indeed, मम my, एतत् this, हि indeed, यत् which, वदामि I speak, आगतस्पृहः eagerly, तत् that, भवद्भिः by you, मम for my, कृते sake, कर्तव्यम् should be done, अनुकम्पया with compassion.

40021473.author: Translation
40021473.content: Rama then stated that the request he was eagerly making should indeed be fulfilled by Agastya out of compassion for him.

40021474.author: पदार्थः
40021474.content: पौरजानपदान् citizens and country-dwellers, स्थाप्य having established, स्वकार्येषु in their own duties, अहम् I, आगतः have come, क्रतून् sacrifices, एव indeed, करिष्यामि I shall perform, प्रभावात् by the power, भवताम् of you, सताम् good ones.

40021474.author: Translation
40021474.content: Having settled the citizens and country-dwellers in their respective duties, I have come here and shall indeed perform sacrifices by the power and influence of you, the virtuous ones.

40021475.author: पदार्थः
40021475.content: सदस्याः members of the assembly, मम my, यज्ञेषु in sacrifices, भवन्तः you, नित्यम् always, एव indeed, तत् that, भविष्यथ you shall be, महावीर्याः of great prowess, मम my, अनुग्रहकाङ्क्षिणः desiring favor.

40021475.author: Translation
40021475.content: You, who are of great prowess and desire my favor, shall always indeed be the members of the assembly in my sacrifices.

40021476.author: पदार्थः
40021476.content: अहम् I, युष्मान् you, समाश्रित्य having resorted to, तपोनिर्धूतकल्मषान् whose sins are cleansed by penance, अनुग्रहीतः blessed, पितृभिः by the ancestors, भविष्यामि I shall be, सुनिर्वृतः greatly contented.

40021476.author: Translation
40021476.content: Having resorted to you, whose sins have been purified by penance, I shall be blessed by my ancestors and thus become greatly contented.

40021477.author: पदार्थः
40021477.content: तत् therefore, आगन्तव्यम् should be come, अनिशम् constantly, भवद्भिः by you, इह here, सङ्गतैः assembled, अगस्त्याद्याः Agastya and others, तु and, तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, ऋषयः sages, संशितव्रताः of firm vows.

40021477.author: Translation
40021477.content: Therefore, you should constantly come here assembled together; and Agastya and other sages of firm vows, having heard that (request)...

40021478.author: पदार्थः
40021478.content: एवम् thus, अस्तु let it be, इति thus, तम् to him, च and, उक्त्वा having said, प्रयातुम् to depart, उपचक्रमुः began.

40021478.author: Translation
40021478.content: ...and having said "So be it" to him, they began to depart.

40021479.author: पदार्थः
40021479.content: एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, गताः went, सर्वे all, ऋषयः sages, ते those, यथागतम् as they had come, राघवः Rama, च and, तम् that, एव indeed, अर्थम् matter, चिन्तयामास pondered, विस्मितः astonished.

40021479.author: Translation
40021479.content: Having spoken thus, all those sages departed the way they had come, and Rama, astonished, pondered over that very matter.

40021480.author: पदार्थः
40021480.content: ततः then, अस्तम् setting, भास्करे when the sun, याते had gone, विसृज्य having dismissed, नृपवानरान् kings and monkeys, सन्ध्याम् evening prayer, उपास्य having performed, विधिवत् according to ritual, तदा then, नरवरोत्तमः the best among men, प्रवृत्तायाम् having commenced, रजन्याम् when night, तु indeed, सः he, अन्तःपुरचरः entered the inner apartments, अभवत् became.

40021480.author: Translation
40021480.content: Then, when the sun had set, having dismissed the kings and monkeys, the best among men, Rama, performed his evening prayers according to ritual, and when night had truly begun, he entered his inner apartments. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे षट्त्रिंशः सर्गः ।। 36 ।। Thus ends the thirty-sixth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
